answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond under one key, pinning each signed claim to one vertex of a claim graph. A zephyr broadcast carries the ordered log for audit replay. At the zenith audit, two claims at one vertex from one key prove equivocation: bond burns, 20 to the prover. At 15 a filing, 1,000 fakes pay 15,000 and lock 60,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Renting a key to double-sign burns both bonds; an honest agent pays 15 once and keeps its bond.
